sound_intent.description: Sample-based arrangement utilizing texture beds and sharp one-shot samples with dark, minimal west coast hip-hop aesthetic.

routing_intent.description: Separate routing per sample slicing technique for tailored effects and mixing clarity.

track_roles.drums: rhythm foundation with sliced one-shot hits
track_roles.bass: deep texture bed using granular samples
track_roles.chords: ambient texture pads from looped samples

designer_intent.goal: Create a minimal dark west coast hip-hop vibe emphasizing hook strength and sparse verses using sample slicing techniques.

presetor_intent.goal: Apply minimal processing presets to preserve sample texture tone and dark mood.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate sparse yet impactful drum patterns emphasizing one-shot sliced samples with groove and swing typical to west coast hip-hop.

bass_generator.brief: Create a deep textured bass layer using granular sample manipulation and minimal melodic movement.

harmony_generator.brief: Design ambient chord pads using looped sample textures to support mood without dominating.

melody_generator.brief: Produce minimal, focused melodic motifs with one-shot samples mainly active during hooks.

ai_designer.brief: Coordinate arrangement energy contour balancing sparse verses and energetic hooks with sample slicing channel organization.

presetor.brief: Implement dark, minimal preset chain focusing on preserving raw sample character and minimal effects.

songgps.brief: Ensure arrangement flow supports sparse verses prominently featuring strong hook segments using the defined section structure.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare unmixed channel audio maintaining clarity for final mixing emphasizing contrast between sparse and energetic parts.
